title: McKinsey problem-solving toolkit candidate registry
description: The structured, filterable, extensible pool of problem-solving frameworks / models / heuristics / techniques / concepts / biases distilled from Cracked It! + Bulletproof Problem Solving — the LOAD substrate for the mckinsey-workflow (thinking-toolkit v1.5) `tool_selection` layer. Each entry classifies a wiki concept by 4S step + type so the engine can FILTER candidates for a sub-need, then read the real content via wiki_path. Structural validity here; file-existence + COMPLETENESS (every book concept registered) is enforced by scripts/cross-tier/validate-frameworks-registry.cjs.

source_books.description: Wiki source slugs the candidates are drawn from.

frameworks.description: The candidate pool — one entry per problem-solving concept.

book.description: Wiki source slug the concept was distilled from.

fours_step.description: Which 4S stage this candidate primarily serves; 'cross' = applies across stages (methods, cognition, guard-rail biases).

type.description: Coarse kind. framework/model/heuristic/technique = tools to LOAD+APPLY; bias/antipattern = guard-rails for the debias/validation gate; concept = principle/idea. A filter hint — the engine reads the content to decide.

wiki_path.description: Path to the concept's full content; the engine Reads (or wiki_asks) this at SELECT time.

title.description: Human display name of the candidate.
